user_input: How does the economic performance of HRAP-AC photosynthetic biogas upgrading compare with pressure swing adsorption (PSA) in terms of CAPEX, OPEX, amortization period, and land requirements?
reference: HRAP-AC has a higher CAPEX but much lower OPEX than PSA. For a 300 Nm3/h plant, CAPEX was €6,034 versus €2,700 per Nm3/h, while OPEX was €0.03 versus €0.18 per Nm3. Despite the higher upfront cost, HRAP-AC had a shorter amortization period (5 vs. 9 years), but required much more land (19 ha vs. 1 ha).
